mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, we are looking at clear skies and 83 degrees near the Verona Public Library, though please note an air quality index of 58, which is in the moderate range.

Two major city items to share. First, the intersection of Nine Mound Road and Mark Drive will close August 5 through August 7 for utility construction. Second, voting is now open online until August 7 for the student-designed I Voted sticker contest for the upcoming November election.

We have a busy day in town today with the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, trivia at The Bogey Factory, and pizza and a pitcher at Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, look forward to Concerts in the Park at Century School Park and Hop Haus trivia.
In a report covering the week, officers handled several calls, including an arrest on Saturday where a driver was taken into custody for an O W I after traveling 97 miles per hour.
Today's flavor of the day is the delightful Caramel Peanut Buttercup. You can also catch Kona Ice around town today at Fireman's Park until 4:30 PM and at the Verona Farmers Market starting at 3 PM.
